channel.description: Latest articles from Nerdist Industries, LLC (nerdist.com)

item.title: Boots Riley to Direct Film of Play Based on THE SIMPSONS
item.description: Director Boots Riley is adapting The Simpsons as a dark comedy. Taken from a stage play, the film reimagines the family we know.

item.title: What Is FALLOUT's Forced Evolutionary Virus? The FEV, Explained
item.description: What is Fallout's Forced Evolutionary Virus? We break down the games' FEV lore and delve into how the virus fits into the Fallout TV series.

item.title: FALLOUT Reveals We Still Don't Know Who Dropped the Bombs
item.description: Fallout season two, episode five made clear we still don't know who dropped the bombs, and that mystery is more intriguing than ever.

item.title: Everything We Know About SCREAM 7
item.description: The Scream franchise is moving forward with another sequel that will bring Sidney Prescott back. Here's everything we know about Scream 7.

item.title: Karl Urban and Priyanka Chopra Jonas Are Dueling Pirates in THE BLUFF Trailer
item.description: Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Karl Urban are two pirates who are constantly trying to kill each other in the trailer for The Bluff.

item.title: Who Dropped the First Nuclear Bombs of the Great War? The FALLOUT Series Is Building an Answer
item.description: Prime Video's Fallout series is answering one of Fallout's biggest questions: Who dropped the first nuclear bombs and started the Great War?

item.title: STAR WARS: Galaxy's Edge at Disneyland Expands Its Timeline
item.description: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Disneyland will finally expand its timeline, adding in several original trilogy characters and themes.

item.title: FALLOUT Season 2: Vault-Tec’s 'Future Enterprise Ventures' Hints at FEV From the Games
item.description: Fallout just introduced the Future Enterprise Ventures experiment, which sounds like a code for the notorious FEV of the video games.

item.title: AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER's New Comic KYOSHI WARRIORS Is Coming This May
item.description: Dark Horse Comics and the creators of Avatar: The Last Airbender are teaming up for a new comic book about the Kyoshi Warriors.

item.title: PILLION’s Sexy Trailer Made Us Giggle and Gasp
item.description: Pillion’s first trailer made us giggle and gasp as things got kinky (and sweet!) between Harry Melling and Alexander Skarsgård.
